name: Soft Words
overview: Scripture emphasizes the power and impact of our words, urging believers to speak with wisdom and grace. Proverbs contrasts harsh speech that wounds like a sword with the healing tongue of the wise, while emphasizing that gentle answers can defuse anger. The New Testament encourages communication that builds up and ministers grace, instructing believers to be thoughtful and gracious in their speech, always ready to respond with wisdom. This teaching calls Christians to be slow to speak and slow to anger, ensuring their words reflect Christ's love and edification.
